jobs_results.title: FULLSTACK DEVELOPER BACK-END FIRST
jobs_results.description:
Buscamos a un profesional con pasión por la tecnología y un enfoque práctico en el desarrollo de backend.

Deberás tener:
• Experiencia avanzada en desarrollo backend: Profundo conocimiento en Python, FastAPI, y Express, con al menos 2-3 años de experiencia en desarrollo backend, incluyendo la implementación de aplicaciones en entornos de producción.
• Creación y consumo de API Rest: Experiencia en el desarrollo y uso de API REST y adopción del enfoque “API First”.
• Arquitectura y diseño de software: Conocimientos en arquitectura hexagonal/limpia y Diseño Dirigido por el Dominio (DDD).
• Gestión de bases de datos complejas: Experiencia en la gestión y optimización de bases de datos relacionales (MySQL, PostgreSQL) y NoSQL (MongoDB), incluyendo bases de datos geolocalizadas y de series temporales.
• Prácticas avanzadas de desarrollo y testing: Experiencia en implementar prácticas de desarrollo de código limpio, SOLID, TDD, y CI/CD utilizando herramientas como Docker y Kubernetes.
•... Integración de tecnologías emergentes: Experiencia en la integración de tecnologías emergentes como GIS, IIoT, IoT, y ML/DL para fortalecer el producto…

Formación académica:

Grado superior en Ingeniería Informática o titulación similar.

Idiomas:

Nivel alto de inglés.

Experiencia:

Mínimo 2-3 años de experiencia como desarrollador back-end.

¡Si buscas un desafío apasionante en el mundo IT, envíanos tu currículum ahora y únete a nuestro equipo de profesionales líderes en el sector

jobs_results.title: Senior Back-end Software Engineer - PHP (Remote within EMEA)
jobs_results.description:
The Company

Printify is a high-growth, print-on-demand platform that connects e-commerce merchants and print-on-demand manufacturers. We work in a fast-paced and ever-developing industry with endless growth opportunities.

James Berdigans, Founder and Executive Chairman of Printify:

“Our mission is to build a platform that lets anyone, anywhere unlock their own personal freedom. The freedom to generate income, be your own boss, and set your schedule. So far we’ve seen more than 6 million people sign up to start their own eCommerce businesses with Printify. Because every order is made on-demand, there’s no risk to getting started, just reward for putting in the work. Our aim is to put this power to build a business into the hands of every person who wants to create their own business.”

The team

We are looking for a Senior Back-end Software Engineer to join our growing Engineering team.

We transform business dreams into awesome digital products. We do this magic through 21 loosely... coupled squads - each specializing in their own area of expertise. These include, but are not limited to, Demand Integrations, Growth, Order, Payments, Supply, and Product Presentation. Printify is a true product company. Each engineering squad works on its own product or area of expertise tirelessly. This yields sustainable, clean code along with less technical debt.

The role

As a back-end engineer, you will play a key role in shaping and delivering a scalable and robust solution. You will be part of the team to bring quality and scalability to the product setup process and tools to a new level, you will follow the best practices in DDD and CQRS.

Passion for writing and improving (clean) code and systems, being a team player with a collaborative approach, sharing knowledge, and humbly learning from others are essential to succeed in this position. Developing in this role will give you the opportunity to grow and move up within the company.

The technology we use
• PHP 8+, Symfony, Doctrine, Laravel framework
• Jenkins, Prometheus, Grafana
• PHPUnit, Postman
• MongoDB, MySQL
• AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, Git
• We also use practices such as Pair Programming, Refactoring, Code Reviews, Weekly Knowledge Sharing sessions, TDD/BDD, A/B testing, and Continuous Delivery which are an important part of our development process

Minimum Qualifications
• Good level of English (spoken and written)
• 5+ years of experience with PHP
• Experience with DDD (Domain-Driven Design)
• Quality-oriented: follow best practices (Testing (ideally TDD), continuous integration/deployment, Agile methodologies) and SOLID principles

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with CQRS (Command Query Responsibility Segregation)
• Experience in architecting new systems or refactoring legacy systems

What to expect as a Back-end Engineer at Printify
• You will work alongside the product teams and product managers to iterate on new features within Printify
• You will take responsibility for the design and execution of your own initiatives
• You will help identify areas of improvement in the codebase and help contribute to making it better
• You will frequently pair with teammates to give and receive feedback from a code review to boost knowledge-sharing, and learning and improve the platform
• You will fix any prioritized bugs/issues tracked within the platform
• You will participate as a presenter or attendee, in weekly coding or knowledge-sharing sessions
• You will learn, develop your soft skills and spend time discussing best practices and technologies with your peers

What we offer
• Stock options so you own a part of Printify
• Opportunity to work fully remote within EMEA time zones
• Work from anywhere - our Printify Houses in Riga or Tallinn, your remote home office, or a co-working hub
• Start your workday anywhere between 7 AM and 11 AM. As long as the job is done and you’re happy and healthy, you can adapt your workflow.
• Apple MacBook laptop as your standard work equipment, covered by Printify
• International relocation support for international candidates who wish to work in Riga or Tallinn
• Access to mentorship, internal meetups, and hackathons both on-site and online
• A learning budget for your professional development based on a position level and access to our book library
• Health insurance or health insurance budget depending on your location and contract type
• Paid health days whenever you need them without a doctor's note depending on your contract type
• Extra paid days off for wellbeing as well as a celebration day of your choosing
• Access to the in-house gym or gym allowance depending on your location and contract type

Our team
• Printifyers come from more than 20 countries
• Our team has grown to more than 600 team members (and growing!)
• We are the 15th America’s fastest-growing company in 2020 (Financial Times

jobs_results.title: Back-End Software Engineer
jobs_results.description:
¿Quieres formar parte por fin de un proyecto estratégico y motivador?

Mirai: ¿quiénes somos?

Somos una empresa con más de 25 años de andadura que trabaja en exclusiva para los hoteles con el objetivo de llevar a su máximo potencial la venta directa. Ofrecemos tecnología, marketing digital y consultoría en distribución.

Tenemos actualmente oficinas en España, Francia, Portugal, México y USA.

Podríamos decir que “necesitamos una persona proactiva, decidida, meticulosa, curiosa, comunicativa, motivada y comprometida”. Pero creemos que es mejor que lo compruebes por tí mismo: ¿Este podrías ser tú?:
• Te gustan los retos y no tienes miedo a equivocarte.
• Te gusta inventar y poner en marcha proyectos nuevos. Eres dinámico y te gustan los cambios.
• Te gusta irte a casa cada día aprendiendo algo nuevo.
• Eres un jugador de equipo, te gusta celebrar las victorias y ayudar a tus compañeros cuando están en problemas.
• Te cuestionas si para cumplir un objetivo la decisión tomada es la... mejor. Y eres flexible: reaccionas, reconoces tus errores e intentas corregirlos.
• Te comprometes con tus tareas hasta el final, sin abandonarlas cuando se complican.
• Eres detallista, pero sabes priorizar y tienes foco para no perderte en los detalles.
• Eres empático, sabes escuchar y comunicar tienes una actitud de mejora continua, ganas e ilusión.

Y, en concreto, como ingeniero del SW, necesitamos que:
• Analizando varias cuestiones en diferentes lugares y momentos, seas capaz de encontrar un patrón.
• Te guste hacer una pequeña prueba aislada antes de seguir con el siguiente paso o aplicar a producción.
• Muestres interés en mejorar nuestro software/arquitectura/infraestructura aportando ideas o soluciones, sin limitarte a "copiar/pegar" lo que ya existe.
• Pruebes nuevas soluciones tecnológicas, pero si las utilizas en nuestro producto, sea siempre con justificación.
• Consideras que las herramientas, entorno, lenguajes de programación, aplicaciones, metodologías y tecnologías son solo medios para llegar al objetivo, y, por tanto, pueden cambiar de uno a otro.
• Tienes no solo capacidad para buscar una solución teórica, sino también de implementarla.
• Además es necesario que puedas comunicarte en inglés con fluidez.

Si eres así, nos interesa conocerte.

¿Qué harás?

Entre nuestros productos tenemos un motor de reservas online que es referente en la industria, integrado con los Metabuscadores de precios más conocidos del sector (Google, TripAdvisor, Trivago, Kayak, SkyScanner). Desarrollamos APIs para que terceras empresas, colaboradoras de nuestros clientes, puedan consumir nuestros datos de manera rápida y precisa.

También nos integramos con diversas pasarelas de pago con el fin de facilitar al hotel el poder cobrar parcial o totalmente sus reservas en el momento en que sus clientes las realizan.

Las tecnologías que actualmente utilizamos son:
• Java 11, Spring Boot
• PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis
• RabbitMQ

Trabajamos con la nube de Amazon y nuestras aplicaciones funcionan sobre Kubernetes. Somos una empresa muy dinámica, como nuestro sector, y nos apoyamos en metodologías ágiles desde hace 15 años.

No queremos vivir del pasado y presente, sino de un futuro prometedor en la industria turística. Hay un recorrido infinito en la utilización de la tecnología en el sector hotelero (Big Data, IoT, nuevos lenguajes más eficientes, bases de datos NoSQL,...) y queremos recorrer ese camino con personas como tú. Como Ingeniero de SW de Mirai, nos ayudarás a conseguirlo.

¿Qué ofrecemos?
• Posibilidad de trabajar desde cualquiera de las oficinas de Mirai de Albufeira, Benidorm, Barcelona, Gijón, Madrid, Palma de Mallorca o París… o teletrabajar desde cualquier lugar en el mundo.
• Trabajamos en un entorno distendido, dinámico y multidisciplinar, y nos esforzamos porque fluya el talento, ser profesionales y fomentar la responsabilidad individual.
• Puesto estable.
• Horario atractivo (L a J de 08 a 17hs y V de 08 a 15. Jornada intensiva en verano durante 3 meses).
• Conciliación familiar REAL: nuestra empresa, con una plantilla joven, pero de gran experiencia, siempre ha estado muy concienciada con las necesidades de conciliación familiar de sus empleados, facilitando desde hace años el trabajo en remoto y ofreciendo cierta flexibilidad horaria.
• Ambiente de trabajo cercano y familiar.
• Las oficinas, ubicadas en el centro de las ciudades, y todas ellas diáfanas, disponen de todo lo necesario para hacer que tu día sea más agradable.
• Trabajamos para vivir y no al contrario.
• Equipo de trabajo joven y experimentado.
• Participación en proyecto estratégico.
• Remuneración salarial en función de tu valía.

¡TE ESPERAMOS

jobs_results.title: .NET Core Back-End Developer - Microservices Expert
jobs_results.description:
We are looking for a .NET Back-End Developer with 5+ years of experience in software development, including a minimum of 3 years focused on web applications using microservices.

QBI Solutions is a provider of software solutions, business intelligence, data analysis and asset management services focused on the renewable energy sector.

We are searching for talented candidates who are proactive and passionate about technology, willing to work in a dynamic and young work environment full of challenges and opportunities.

We are looking for a .NET Back-End Developer with 5+ years of experience in software development, including a minimum of 3 years focused on web applications using microservices.

Main Responsibilities:
• and develop a migration of a project to a scalable and high-performance microservices architecture using .NET Core.
• in the entire application lifecycle, focused on writing high quality secure code, debugging and meeting deadlines.
• evaluate and analyze technical and... design requirements.

Required Skills and Qualifications:
• experience in designing and implementing Microservices architecture.
• in back-end development using Microsoft Visual Studio IDE and.NET Core Framework (C#) focused on web applications using microservices architecture.
• withEntity Framework and LINQ language
• with architecture APIs(REST)
• develop, and maintainSQL databases for scalability
• with code versioning tools (Git).
• problem-solving capabilities and a positive attitude.
• to learn new technologies and concepts.

Suitable Skills:
• with Microsoft Azure platform.
• to apply commonly accepted best-practices: Agile methodologies (SCRUM), continuous integration / DevOps (VSTS/Azure DevOps).
• of additional databases (No-SQL) or back-end languages (Python).
• understanding of renewable energies sector will be valuable.

Working conditions:
• Hybrid work based in Madrid (60% remote).
• salary package and career development opportunities.

QBI Solutions is a provider of software solutions, business intelligence, data analysis and asset management services focused on the renewable energy sector.

We are searching for talented candidates who are proactive and passionate about technology, willing to work in a dynamic and young work environment full of challenges and opportunities

jobs_results.title: Senior Backend Software Engineer
jobs_results.description:
ABOUT STRANDS

Strands is a leading fintech company at the forefront of innovation in the financial industry. Our cutting-edge solutions empower banks and financial institutions to deliver personalized and intelligent banking experiences. Our products are fully embedded with Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning capabilities so joining us is a great opportunity to be at the forefront of this new revolution.

With more than 100 employees worldwide we still work as a startup. Since 2020 we are part of the CRIF group, a world leader in the Financial Sector. So we have the best of both worlds, we operate as a startup and we are backed by a big company!

ABOUT THE ROLE

Love the smell of fresh code in the morning? Are you a passionate developer and a need to be challenged? Do you want to be part of a team that develops innovative and lasting product?

Strands is waiting for you! You will join our Engineering Team and help design and develop an innovative FinTech software that... enables banks to offer personalised digital banking experiences.

Reporting to the Backend Technical Lead, the candidate will work on the development of sophisticated and innovative backend solutions in a fast-paced, dynamic and international team.

You will do things like...
• Design the architecture of our platform with our Backend Architect
• Programming highly-available software and innovative functionality
• Work with Kafka and other messaging systems
• Analyse requirements and solutions to provide the best software experience.
• Troubleshooting and issue resolution.
• Understanding of Java server-side technologies.

You'll do it using your...
• Compelling working experience in a Java 8/JEE/Kotlin/Scala back-end environment (preferably using Agile / Scrum methodology)
• Excellent knowledge of SOLID principles and design patterns
• Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and why they are important
• Build reliable, highly available, and scalable software on top of streaming platforms like Kafka/ AMQP / Google Pub/Sub technologies.
• Developing REST-based APIs.
• Experience in SQL/NoSQL technologies

You'll love it because you will get...
• Competitive salary;
• Private health care insurance;
• Gym free pass;
• Meal vouchers;
• Subscription to unlimited online training courses by Udemy;
• Flexible working hours;
• Snacks and food, Fresh organic fruit, drinks, tea, coffee and juices;
• Cutting-edge technologies;
• Hybrid model of working from home and office attendance.

Don’t hesitate to apply even if you are not sure to cover all requirements, we would love to see your profile

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, two things are essential to continuing our success: our people and our culture. We've been officially certified as a Great Place to Work™ in recognition of our outstanding employee experience! So far, we have 10,000+ people working around the world, from our great offices or remotely, on our mission. And we're looking for more. We want brilliant people that love building great products, love redefining success, and love turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About The Role

Our Technology team isn’t just one of the best in the... industry, it’s one of the best in the world. And we’re proud of it. It’s our driving force; our engine 🚀 From building a new banking backend to creating an award-winning app, there’s nothing (and we mean nothing) our tech team can’t do. Our Technology team isn’t here to fix legacy systems – it’s here to build world-class financial products from the ground up. Products that will be used by millions of people around the world 🌎

We’re looking for a Backend Engineer who wants to change the world. If you like to work at a steady pace with no surprises, keep scrolling. If you want your work to change the global financial landscape, you might just be who we’re looking for. We have a minimalist approach to using external frameworks, with emphasis on maintainability and fast turnaround with TDD, DDD and Continuous Integration & Delivery.

Our technology stack:
• Java 17
• GCP
• Kubernetes
• Docker
• PostgreSQL
• Redis
• Spock
• SparkJava
• JOOQ and TDD approach

Watch this video to discover how our Engineering department is structured and what we expect from our brilliant engineers. If you’re up for the challenge of shaping the future of finance, let’s get in touch.

What You’ll Be Doing
• Building mobile APIs
• Developing micro services to evolve our architecture
• Perfecting a number of systems that our business depends on, like risk management, fraud detection, and payment processing
• Focusing on greenfield development and improvement of existing systems

What You'll Need
• Fluency with Java
• 6+ years of experience in back-end development
• A bachelor's degree (or above) in computer science, maths, physics, or similar field
• To be a quick learner with an ambitious attitude and results-driven personality
• The ability to work well as part of a team in a fast-paced environment
• Excellent communication and organisational skills
• Fluency in English

Nice to have
• Experience with Kotlin
• Experience within Finance
• Experience in a start-up or scale-up
• Experience in a product-focused environment

We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. jobs_results.title: Senior Full Stack Developer [España]
jobs_results.description:
Noctorial es una Firma de Trading Propietario y estamos buscando un Full Stack Developer con amplia experiencia desarrollando software. Buscamos una persona que haya podido tocar tanto el Front-end como el Back-end y que quiera aprender y trabajar con herramientas No-Code/Low-Code.

Para nosotros es fundamental que el nuevo integrante comparta nuestra cultura de empresa y tenga interés por el trading y las nuevas tecnologías.

TL;DR
• Trabajo 100% remoto (Europa)
• Remuneración mensual.
• Posibilidad de empezar cuanto antes.
• Relación laboral: Autónomo.
• Colaboración a largo plazo.

¿Qué harás diariamente?
• Desarrollo de software: Análisis de requisitos, implementación, testing y deployment con las tecnologías de Bubble, Make, Airtable y Xano.
• Garantía de calidad del código: Escribir código limpio, bien estructurado, mantenible y escalable acorde a las necesidades del negocio.
• Mantenimiento de código: Actualización y mantenimiento del código existente, mejorar el rendimiento y... agregar nuevas características según sean requeridas.
• Documentación: Escribir documentación técnica clara, trabajamos con proveedores externos en varios procesos y debemos documentar todo.

Las habilidades que más valoramos:
• Capacidad de resolución de problemas.
• Buscamos a alguien que sea muy organizado y preciso.
• Tengas experiencia demostrable con cualquier lenguaje de programación.

Eres la persona que buscamos si tienes...
• +5 años de experiencia desarrollando software con cualquier tecnología.
• Ganas de aprender y trabajar en Bubble, Xano, Airtable, Make y cualquier tecnología
• Experiencia consumiendo APIs.
• Conocimientos básicos de HTML, JS y CSS para mostrar datos y crear interacciones con los usuarios en Bubble.
• Contar con al menos una experiencia en un proyecto complejo.
• Conocimientos de SCRUM y metodologías ágiles.
• Mentalidad positiva.
• Jugador de equipo.

Formarás parte de una empresa financiera con muchas oportunidades para crecer dentro de la organización, somos creativos y dinámicos con una cultura joven e internacional

jobs_results.description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, more freedom. And since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. With an arsenal of awesome products that span spending, saving, travel, transfers, investing, exchanging and more, we've helped 40+ million customers get more from their money. And we're not done yet.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, two things are essential to continuing our success: our people and our culture. We've been officially certified as a Great Place to Work™ in recognition of our outstanding employee experience! So far, we have 10,000+ people working around the world, from our great offices or remotely, on our mission. And we're looking for more. We want brilliant people that love building great products, love redefining success, and love turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About The Role

Our Technology team isn’t just one of the best in the... industry. It's one of the best in the world. And we’re proud of it. It’s our driving force — our engine 🚀

From building a new financial backend to creating an innovative app, there’s nothing (and we mean nothing) our tech team can’t do. Our Technology team isn’t here to fix legacy systems — it’s here to build world-class financial features from the ground up. Products that'll be used by millions of people around the world 🌎

We’re looking for a Lead Backend Engineer who wants to change the world. If you like to work at a steady pace with no surprises, keep scrolling. If you want your work to change the global financial landscape, you might be just who we’re looking for. We have a minimalist approach to using external frameworks, with an emphasis on maintainability and fast turnaround with TDD, DDD, and Continuous Integration & Delivery.

Our technology stack:
• Java 17
• GCP
• Kubernetes
• Docker
• PostgreSQL
• Redis
• Spock
• SparkJava
• JOOQ and TDD approach

Watch this video to discover how our Engineering department is structured and what we expect from our brilliant engineers. If you’re up for the challenge of shaping the future of finance, let’s get in touch.

What You’ll Be Doing
• Leading and mentoring backend engineers, providing guidance and direction on best practices and technical decisions
• Participating in performance reviews and building growth plans for engineers
• Designing, documenting, and implementing solutions, using Domain-Driven Design, CQRS/ES, and event-driven architecture patterns on a global scale
• Collaborating with cross-functional teams to improve engineering processes and raising a bar for quality and efficiency
• Building mobile APIs and developing micro services to evolve our architecture
• Perfecting a number of systems that our business depend on, like risk management, fraud detection, payment processing, etc.
• Focusing mostly on greenfield development and improvement of existing systems

What You'll Need
• Fluency with Java
• 8+ years experience in back-end development
• A bachelor's degree (or above) in computer science, maths, physics, or a similar area of study
• A proven track record of contributing to process improvements, as well as mentoring and training team members
• An ambitious and results-driven personality
• Excellent communication and organisational skills
• Working experience with Domain-Driven Design principles, practices, and patterns
• Working experience with scalable distributed systems
• Knowledge of different architectural patterns
• Knowledge of DevOps principles and practices
• Fluency in English

Nice to have
• Experience with Kotlin and Scala
• Experience within finance
• Experience within a start-up or scale-up
• Experience within a product-focused environment

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.
